description: This file defines the class RequestToField, which is a method operation in the MiniLang framework for Apache OFBiz. It implements the <request-to-field> element, enabling the transfer of request attribute values into a specified field within the method context, with optional default value handling.

classes.name: RequestToField
classes.description: Implements the <request-to-field> element, facilitating the movement of request attributes to method fields with optional default values.

classes.name: RequestToField.RequestToFieldFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of RequestToField.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RequestToField object based on XML element and method context, validating attributes and preparing expanders.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation, retrieving request attribute values and setting them into the specified field, with fallback to default.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, mainly for debugging.
